skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

llm.summary: This skill is a local Chinese-language checker for clinic cashier daily reconciliation tables and does not show hidden execution, persistence, destructive actions, or data exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads only a user-specified input file or bundled sample and uses the bundled local engine. Grep and direct review found no fetch/http/https/net/dns/tls imports, child process use, environment-variable reads, credential access, or filesystem writes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time script, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, package manager hook, or setup mutation was found in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to user-provided table input and sample execution. The package is Chinese-language and domain-specific, with English metadata present, but runtime output is fixed in Chinese.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, memory modification, or system configuration change was found. There is a disclosure inconsistency: run.mjs text mentions an anonymous usage statistic and --no-stats, but the inspected code does not implement networking or that flag.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe deterministic checks for outpatient cashier/refund daily reconciliation tables; the runner and engine implement arithmetic, totals, duplicate, blank, and negative-amount checks matching that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using a Chinese-language local checker for exported cashier reconciliation table text. Provide only the specific reconciliation file you want checked. The reviewed version did not send data over the network, but its help text inconsistently mentions anonymous usage statistics, so review future versions if that behavior matters to you.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded after inspection: scripts/run.mjs was present and fully inspected; it loads the bundled engine and processes either --sample or a user-specified input file.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only runtime text is consistent with a Chinese clinic reconciliation workflow; it is a usability/localization limitation rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The comment mentioning pasted contract text is an inaccurate example, but the actual help text, parser requirements, and engine checks remain focused on clinic cashier reconciliation tables.
[SQP-2] expected: Reading the path supplied through --input is expected for a local file-based checker and is disclosed in usage text; no broad filesystem scanning or hidden file access was found.
